visual_action: A montage of clips from a Medal of Honor ceremony at the White House. President Donald Trump is shown awarding the medal to three different recipients on a stage in front of several American and military branch flags. The first recipient is an elderly Black veteran. The second is a younger white serviceman. The third is a white man in a suit who receives the medal in a framed case.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown on screen throughout the video leading the ceremony and awarding the medals.

cast.name: unnamed elderly Black veteran
cast.evidence: He is shown in the first clip receiving the Medal of Honor from Donald Trump.

cast.name: unnamed white serviceman
cast.evidence: He is shown in the second clip receiving the Medal of Honor from Donald Trump.

cast.name: unnamed man in a suit
cast.evidence: He is shown in the third clip receiving a framed Medal of Honor from Donald Trump.

on_screen_text.text: Medal of Honor Ceremony at the White House

spoken_summary: The audio consists of the natural sounds of the award ceremony. In one clip, Donald Trump jokes that the medal "is not coming off now," which elicits laughter from the audience. The rest of the audio is primarily applause for the medal recipients.
audio_music: The audio is entirely diegetic sound from the event itself, including applause, indistinct murmuring, laughter, and brief spoken remarks. There is no musical score.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage of three different award presentations, using hard cuts to transition between them. The shots within each clip are static and filmed from a fixed perspective.
central_claim: Donald Trump is a president who honors the nation's military heroes in formal White House ceremonies.
intended_effect: To evoke feelings of patriotism and respect, and to portray Donald Trump in a positive, presidential light.
uncertainty_flags: The names of the Medal of Honor recipients are not identified in the video.
